title: GenA 2.0
subtitle: Upload a document and get ready-to-use questions with quality validation and sensitivity assessment.
quickStartHint: Three steps from a document to ready-to-use questions. Click a step to open the relevant page.
step1Desc: Upload a document, select question types, and start generation.
step2Desc: Follow the process from document chunking to ready-to-use questions.
step3Desc: Review the generated questions, edit if needed, and download them in Excel or GIFT format.
aboutP1: GenA (Generation & Sensitivity Assessment) helps create accurate and socially safe questions from documents.
aboutP2: Three question types: single choice, multiple choice, and open-ended.
aboutP3: Sensitivity indicates how controversial or potentially conflict-prone the topic of a question may be. Questions are assigned a sensitivity level from 1 to 3:
aboutP4: Questions undergo quality validation. Ready-to-use questions can be reviewed, edited, and downloaded.
